title: Born Again: the New Birth
aka: born of water and the Spirit
lead: The Bible pictures God giving people a new beginning as a birth: a new heart and a new spirit (Ezekiel 36:26), being "born from above" or "born again" of water and Spirit (John 3:3–8), "born of God" (1 John 3:9), and a washing that brings rebirth (Titus 3:5). Christians agree it is God's work, and differ on how it relates to baptism and to faith.

sections.h: From the prophets to the apostles
sections.b: The prophets promised that God would wash his people and give them a new heart and his own Spirit (Ezekiel 36:25–27), and write his law on their hearts (Jeremiah 31:33). Jesus tells Nicodemus that no one can see God's kingdom without being born anōthen, a Greek word that means both "again" and "from above" (John 3:3). The letters speak of God giving "new birth" through the word of truth (James 1:18; 1 Peter 1:23) and of a washing of rebirth and renewal by the Holy Spirit (Titus 3:5).
